 Follow Breakfast Food Recall Expands as More Products Face Listeria Concerns Across 7 States
 Duane Beckett Thu, November 19, 2026 at 12:30 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Duane Beckett (OpenAI) Fresh & Ready Foods LLC has expanded its breakfast food recall to seven states over concerns that certain products may be contaminated with Listeria. 
 The latest recall includes sausage, egg, and cheese biscuit sandwiches , along with biscuit and sausage gravy meals.
 According to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) , the company announced the expanded recall on November 17, 2026. The products were made at its Longview, Texas, facility and distributed between October 15 and November 11.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Fortunately, no illnesses have been reported in connection with the affected products.
 Which breakfast products are being recalled?
 Two products manufactured at the company's Longview facility are included in the expanded recall.
 FDA recall image showing the Fresh to You Sausage, Egg, Cheese biscuit sandwich. Credit: FDA recall announcement
 Fresh to You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwich
 Package size: 5.7 ounces
 SKU: 3100048
 Fresh Thru dates: November 12 through November 22, 2026
 Packaging: Clear plastic film
 States: Alabama, Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma, Tennessee, and Texas
 Mmm! Meals Made in Minutes Biscuit & Sausage Gravy
 Package size: 9.5 ounces
 SKU: 90013
 Expiration dates: November 12 through November 18, 2026
 Packaging: Clear plastic clamshell
 States: Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma, Tennessee, and Texas
 FDA image showing the front label of a recalled biscuit and sausage gravy sandwich. Credit: FDA recall announcement
 Both products have their dates printed on the front label.
 Advertisement Advertisement This expansion follows an earlier breakfast sandwich recall involving 2,414 sandwiches distributed in Washington and Oregon.
 The FDA's latest announcement confirms that no other products made at Fresh & Ready Foods' Longview or Renton facilities have been identified as affected.
 Why are these breakfast foods being recalled?
 Fresh & Ready Foods confirmed that supplier C.H. Guenther & Son had expanded its recall of certain biscuits that could contain Listeria monocytogenes.
 That prompted the company to recall additional foods containing those ingredients.
 Listeria can cause a serious infection called listeriosis. Older adults, pregnant women, newborns, and people with weakened immune systems face the greatest risks.
 Advertisement Advertisement Symptoms can include fever, muscle aches, headaches, nausea, diarrhea, and a stiff neck. More serious infections may cause confusion, loss of balance, and convulsions.
 Pregnant women also face serious complications. 
 What should you do if you have a recalled product?
 Anyone who purchased one of the affected products should avoid eating it and discard it immediately.
 Check the package name, weight, SKU, and date carefully. The FDA has also published product photographs to help consumers identify the recalled foods.
 For questions or a full refund, contact Fresh & Ready Foods at 1-855-424-8390, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET. Consumers can also email RecallConcern@HotLineGlobal.com.
 Advertisement Advertisement Anyone experiencing symptoms after eating a recalled product should contact a healthcare provider, particularly if they're in a higher-risk group. Be sure to mention the possible exposure to Listeria.
